agentPrompts.enter5:
Enter today's AgentDraw — BNB Chain (56).
Contract: <CONTRACT_ADDRESS>
Call enter(5) · selector 0xa59f3e0c · value 2500000000000000 wei (5 × 0.0005 BNB = 0.0025 BNB) · gasLimit 300000.
Price rule: exactly 500000000000000 wei per ticket, 1–20 tickets per call. 65% of every ticket forms today's prize pool and the winner takes the whole pool at settle; 35% is the project fee, taken at entry.
Check first (stop and name any failure): my wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F > 0) · paused()=false.
No approvals. Reply with the tx link only.
agentPrompts.settle:
Settle the oldest unsettled AgentDraw day — BNB Chain (56). Only after 00:00 UTC.
Contract: <CONTRACT_ADDRESS>
Call settleDay() · selector 0xca624b77 · value 0 · gasLimit 300000. Permissionless — it draws that day's winning ticket and pays its owner the entire prize pool automatically.
No approvals. Reply: tx link + the winner from dayWinner for the settled day.

description: Daily on-chain draw for Binance .ai Agent ID holders on BNB Chain. No NFT: buy tickets for 0.0005 BNB each; 65% of every ticket forms the day's prize pool and one winning ticket per UTC day takes the whole pool at the permissionless 00:00 UTC settle. The 35% project fee is taken at entry.
drawDay: UTC day (block.timestamp / 86400); entries count only for the day they were bought on
entryGate: caller must hold a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on the registry > 0), checked on every entry
name: AgentDraw
ownerFeeTiming: credited instantly at entry (owner cut per entry call = msg.value * 35 / 100, remainder to the pool; always exact at the constant price: 0.000175 BNB fee + 0.000325 BNB pool per ticket)
ownerPowers: setPaused (entries only), withdraw fee balance. Owner cannot touch prize pools, change the ticket price or the 65/35 split, or pick a winner.
prizeAtSettle: winner receives 100% of the day's accumulated prize pool
randomnessDisclosure: winning ticket = keccak256(day, totalTickets, blockhash(block.number - 1)) at settle time, mod totalTickets, 1-based, mapped across the day's cumulative entry ranges. Publicly verifiable after the settle tx is mined; NOT VRF-grade — the settler chooses when to call and timing can influence the result.
settle: permissionless settleDay() after the day ends (00:00 UTC); one day per call, oldest unsettled first; zero-entry days settle with no winner
